English.Char_Desc_250: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows: real-time CPU, GPU, RAM, storage and network telemetry in an always-visible overlay, plus fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting.
English.Char_Desc_450: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay, and its Control Center sets fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting. Portrait/landscape profiles, wallpaper mode, game overlay and per-fan curves that run with the app closed.
English.Char_Desc_2000: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitor and control center for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay, and its Control Center sets fan curves, power profiles and RGB lighting. Features sparkline panels, portrait/landscape profiles, wallpaper mode, floating overlay, in-game FPS overlay, Fill Screen mode, auto-updater, and a bundled sensor service powered by LibreHardwareMonitor. Control Center profiles switch from the tray and bundle a Windows power plan and per-fan curves that keep running with the app closed; on supported AMD hardware they also set Ryzen PPT/TDC/EDC limits, Curve Optimizer undervolting and the Radeon GPU power limit. Lighting covers ASUS Aura Sync, ROG peripherals, Windows Dynamic Lighting devices and Philips Hue. Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Free and open source, no telemetry, no bloat.
